title: Validate successful LTE initial attach and detach for multiple UEs under excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that multiple UEs can successfully attach and detach to/from an LTE cell according to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1 under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Network setup is a single LTE cell with all other cells powered off
Multiple UEs (at least 2) placed in cell center with excellent LTE RSRP as per Clause 4.6
Test configuration parameters are recorded
End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the provided test configuration
Start log capture for call flows and signaling messages
Power ON multiple UEs simultaneously to trigger LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach confirmation from all UEs
Verify UE logs/application confirm attachment to correct cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Power OFF multiple UEs simultaneously to trigger LTE detach procedure
Wait for successful detach confirmation from all UEs
Stop and save logs for analysis
Repeat attach-detach cycle 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% for all UEs in all iterations
Detach success rate is 100% for all UEs in all iterations
Attach latency measured for each UE with minimum, average, and maximum recorded
Signaling messages confirm proper attach and detach procedures as per 3GPP
No connectivity issues or failures during test
commandsUsed: Generic commands: Power ON/OFF UEs, start/stop log capture
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach/detach success
Check signaling message flows for Attach Request, Attach Complete, Detach Request, Detach Accept
Measure attach latency timestamps between Attach Request and Attach Complete

title: Validate successful 5G NSA attach and detach with Secondary Node addition and release for multiple UEs
description: Verify multiple UEs can successfully perform attach and detach procedures in 5G NSA mode with EN-DC Secondary Node addition and release as per 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340.
preconditions: Network setup is a single 5G NSA cell with LTE and NR nodes activated, other cells off
Multiple UEs placed in cell center with excellent 5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational without connectivity issues

Start log capture for call flow and signaling
Power ON multiple UEs simultaneously to trigger 5G NSA attach including EN-DC Secondary Node addition
Wait for successful attach and Secondary Node addition confirmation for all UEs
Verify UE logs/applications confirm correct cell attachment (PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)
Power OFF multiple UEs simultaneously to trigger detach including Secondary Node release
Wait for successful detach and Secondary Node release confirmation for all UEs
Stop and save logs for analysis
Repeat attach-detach cycle 10 times
expectedResults: Attach success rate and Secondary Node addition success rate are 100% for all UEs
Detach success rate including Secondary Node release is 100% for all UEs
Signaling messages confirm procedures as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1, 5.3.8.2.1 and TS 37.340 Clauses 10.2.1 and 10.4.1
No connectivity or signaling failures during test
commandsUsed: Generic commands: Power ON/OFF UEs, start/stop log capture
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs for attach, Secondary Node addition, detach, and Secondary Node release success
Check signaling flows for Attach Request, Attach Complete, SgNB Addition Request, SgNB Reconfiguration Complete, Detach Request, Detach Accept, SgNB Release Request, SgNB Release Acknowledge
Validate UE attachment to correct LTE and 5G cells using PCI, Global eNB/gNB IDs
